title: Cookie-based login
text: The cookie-based login method is the easiest approach for enabling login on your MobiLoud app. On most websites, when a user goes through the authentication process, a cookie is generated and stored on the browser. That cookie holds a token, which is then used by the website to revalidate the user login without having to ask for the username and password to be provided again. MobiLoud allows you to use that cookie to determine if the user is logged in or not. ⚠️ IMPORTANT! text: A D-U-N-S Number is a number that is used to identify your business. A DUNS number is a unique nine-character identification number Dun Bradstreet provides free of charge.
